_comment: Single source of truth for the analysis scripts (analyze_benchmark, generate_figures, judge_reliability, export_groundtruth_results, groundtruth_stats, plot_order_sensitivity). size_b = total parameters as reported by `ollama show`; size_b_nominal = size in the model name, as used in the paper (Finding A). family groups models from the same vendor lineage, used for family-level self-preference. color = Okabe-Ito palette, one per model. sets.paper = the 4 models of the arXiv v1 analyses.
